page.notes: The printed line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 in the left margin are marked as notes at their positions, although their placement in the marked lines is approximate; the number 20 falls before "enim", 25 before "pellatione", 30 before "mens", and 35 before "qui" in the printed text. Line numbering in the transcription above is not exact against the printed lines and should be checked against the scan. Greek passages (βαθμὸν…, καθ' ἑαυτὴν…) are read from a low-resolution scan; the words marked [?] are doubtful. Italic type of the first paragraph and of the "Duo, inquit" passage is marked with <i>; the underlined "Quòd" and "Quamdiu" are not marked as separate emphasis. The "VI." section number is treated as a paragraph opener, per the rules, not as a heading. Probable printing error: "philosophi" in "non veri sitis philosophi affirmo" is printed as shown and left unchanged.
